items.text: The game no longer softlocks after pressing the "~" (tilde) button.
Some buildable icons have been updated.
The UI no longer locks up when building a coal mine.
Clicking on the "Spacebar to continue" text no longer triggers the filling circle animation during cutscenes.
Some buildable icons have been updated.
Cleanup has been improved to help prevent frequent stuttering.
Cutscene loading has been further improved.
Loading screen images now display at the correct resolution.
The Quality Mode setting is now correctly applied when set from the main menu.
Gold mine, silver mine, and clay mine no longer appear unnecessarily in the radial menu.
Render texture handling has been improved to increase stability.
Some buildable icons have been updated.
The custom controller/keyboard binding loader now adds missing default bindings.
Workers can now be dismissed from the Workstation panel.
Input hints are now shown during food selection.
The residents panel now uses a more contextual layout.
House panel navigation layout and behavior have been updated for better usability.
The animal data cell layout has been updated to prevent text from being cut off.
The Pantry panel is now fully localized.
Panel highlighting has been updated for better readability.
The Settlers panel now displays all icons correctly.
New glyphs for gamepad have been added.
NPCs that get stuck in a building, in the air, or in an off-navmesh location are now automatically repositioned.
Glyphs in notes have been updated to the new atlas.
Controllers are now supported in the main menu.
Missing controller bindings for DualSense controllers are now available.
The hotkey icon for the Lift Up action now displays correctly.
Incorrect icons in the icons database are now correct.
The glyph for enabling filters on the transport screen now displays correctly.
The button prompt for "Filters" in the Storage Management tab now displays correctly.
Button prompts now appear correctly across all Craft tabs.
Players can now scroll through the item list in the Pantry.
Checkboxes in the Management missions tab are now marked correctly when completed.
The button prompt for waypoint removal now appears on the Map tab.
The furniture list no longer exceeds the allocated window on the Rent Out panel.
Text in the Pantry menu is now an appropriate size.
The Analyze icon and Equipped icon are now the same size.
The radial menu is no longer accessible on the trade screen.
Number combinations in the 'Craft multiple' progress UI no longer display as fractions.
The "Buildings" entry in the Journal tab no longer overflows the text border in some languages.
Button prompts on the Management tab now display in the correct case.
All relevant buttons are now visible in the Workstation tab, not just "Hire".
Active subpanels in the Manage panel are now highlighted correctly.
Sub-navigation in the Manage panel is now easier to read.
The Workers panel highlight now displays more clearly when selecting assignable buildings.
Building list navigation now works automatically after the panel opens.
Food selection for animals and settlers now has a more intuitive UI.
The houses list in the Residents tab now displays more clearly.
The workplaces list in the Residents tab now displays more clearly.
The houses list is now easier to navigate.
Highlight in the Warehouse tab (Management) now displays more clearly.
Highlight in the Settlers contextual panel now displays more clearly.
Highlight in the Settlers tab list now displays more clearly.
The buildings list selection highlight now displays more clearly.
Item descriptions now display correctly in the storage menu.
The chest panel now registers navigation input on the first press.
Chest selection now starts from the first row.
Item descriptions now display correctly, loading only after the details panel has initialized.
The trash button now registers clicks correctly.
The buildings list now supports mouse scrolling.
The active panel now refreshes correctly when a mine building is selected (stone/iron/sawmill).
The interaction button now correctly opens selected house details.
Hotkeys are no longer missing when placing objects or furniture.
The hotkey for adding/removing guards in the management panel is now correct.
Filters in the transport panel now work correctly with mouse and keyboard.
The gamepad glyph now displays correctly when purchasing small farm animals.
Scrolling now works correctly when changing workplace in the Settlers Management tab.
Players no longer lose focus after equipping/unequipping tools & weapons.
The pause menu is now fully interactive with the D-pad.
The selected building index no longer resets continuously when using a gamepad.
The food state can now be changed with a gamepad.
The D-pad now works correctly in the food selection panel.
D-pad navigation in the building list now works correctly.
Horizontal D-pad navigation is now supported.
Navigation events are no longer sent to multiple lists simultaneously.
Only the active list now holds focus when switching between the player and chest item lists.
Changing a filter no longer causes focus to be lost when the new category contains fewer items.
Closing the quantity selection popup no longer closes the entire chest panel.
Input on the chest panel is now blocked while the quantity selection popup is open.
Crafting can now be canceled using a controller.
Journal navigation with gamepad now works correctly.
D-Pad navigation issues on DualSense have been fixed (may require restoring controller settings to default).
Navigation in the Settlers panel on DualSense now works correctly (may require restoring controller settings to default).
The DualSense controller now works correctly on the Map panel.
The DualSense controller now works correctly on the map in the Management Panel.
The touchpad icon for the DualSense controller now displays correctly.
Floor height adjustment using D-Pad Up/Down now works correctly.
Players can no longer place fences on farm fields.
Players can now move while placing a building when holding a weapon.
Resources in FPV mode can now be collected without needing to get too close to them.
Equipped clothing can no longer be dropped while the player is wearing it.
Items now disappear from the Radial Menu after the player uses the place or drop option.
Players can now destroy Pigstry and Goat shed buildings without needing to reload the save.
Players are no longer pushed far away when going through building doors.
The skill points number now updates in real time after unlocking 3 skills.
The "New level 1" pop-up no longer appears every time the player levels up.
Identical items now stack correctly instead of appearing as separate entries.
Sold animals now disappear immediately after being sold.
Orders can now be placed in the General Store.
Players can now navigate between active transports.
The same transport can no longer be canceled multiple times.
Canceled transports now disappear immediately when canceled right after creation.
Players can no longer navigate to an empty row in the Rent House panel.
The building menu can no longer be opened while placing a fence.
Skills can now be upgraded twice in a row.
Clay mine and Gold mine now build as the correct mine type.
Building a coal mine no longer breaks the player's camera or prevents cancellation.
The workbench can no longer be destroyed during the crafting process.
Replacing a worker now correctly removes the previous worker.
The ingredients list now disappears correctly when exiting Production and New Production panels.
The looped option toggle in the New Production panel now works correctly.
The workers list now auto-selects the first worker when focused.
Empty resident slots in the residents list can no longer be selected.
Resident info now refreshes correctly after selection.
The house selection panel now closes correctly when dismissed.
The workplace selection panel now closes correctly when dismissed.
Resident count in houses now displays as a whole number instead of a fraction.
Switching between houses on the houses list now works correctly.
The house ownership toggle now works correctly.
The first house is now auto-selected.
Relocating residents to another house now works correctly.
Navigating the houses list no longer scrolls the residents list simultaneously.
Selecting a house now correctly updates the house info.
The residents list is now visible when opened from house settings.
Workers now appear correctly in the animal pen management panel.
Empty data cells in multiple panels can no longer be selected.
A worker can now be dismissed from a building even if another worker is assigned there.
Data cells no longer lose focus after a hire/dismiss action.
Resident assignment in the Manage panel now counts toward the appropriate missions.
The settler's workstation now updates immediately after changing the active settler in the Management panel.
The "Change" button in the Settlers menu in the Management panel has been disabled — settlers can be assigned to buildings in the Buildings section.
NPCs now go to work in the Shed building correctly.
NPCs can no longer float in the air.
NPCs can now find their way home correctly.
NPCs are less likely to get stuck while navigating.
NPCs in homes are now detected and interact with furniture more reliably.
NPCs now sit at the correct height on furniture instead of floating above it.
NPCs no longer move in the background during the NPC house rental panel.
NPCs no longer end up outside their house after loading a save created at a large distance from the house.
The stone knife and Carpenter's hammer now work correctly.
The live hare trap now displays with the correct icon in the relevant craft branch.
The active item can now be unequipped during crafting without breaking animations.
Multiple crafting actions can no longer be triggered simultaneously.
The item change menu can no longer be opened during crafting.
The saddle list in horse inventory now works correctly with a gamepad.
Resources can now be correctly filtered on the transport screen.
Items no longer disappear after reaching max transport quantity, allowing quantity changes and removal.
The resource selection panel now closes correctly after sending transport.
Shop items now display as grouped correctly.
Words in the item quantity selection and cooking windows no longer wrap mid-word in Ukrainian localization.
The tooltip text "No city to select" in the Management tab is now localized in all languages.
The text description for the Thick-skinned skill is now available in Ukrainian and Russian.
The acquired quantity of resources needed for a quest no longer displays as "Null" in RU and UA languages.
The status message now correctly shows "Overheating" instead of "Freezing" after changing game language.
Map region localization text now displays more accurately.
The Manage button for houses is now correctly localized.
The Manage button for houses now uses the correct color.
Wall category icons in house management now display more accurately.
The POI scroll area no longer causes text to overlap.
The "Spacebar to skip" text on the cutscene screen now respects the active localization.
Outdoor decoration names now match the names shown in the radial menu.
Objective progress is now displayed correctly in The Promise quest.
The correct cutscene now plays for the quest "Sleep with Mercedes".
Objects' names no longer disappear or become non-interactable after reloading the save.
Memory is now correctly cleared if the house rename panel closes unexpectedly during editing.
Paul's gunpowder now saves correctly.
Runtime objects now save correctly.
Technology state now saves and loads correctly.
The camera no longer becomes disengaged from the character after loading a save created while a gun was equipped.
Characters now animate correctly in the Inventory when time is stopped.
The glyph conflict between cutscenes and Spacebar has been resolved.
Settings category icons are now highlighted correctly.

In some cases, if a building is placed on a high foundation, NPCs may not be able to properly navigate to their destination. This can cause them to walk around the building instead of reaching the target point. As a temporary workaround, NPCs may occasionally be repositioned to the correct location.
In some cases, NPCs may appear in a T-pose after loading the game. Moving away from the NPC should cause the issue to resolve automatically.
NPCs may sometimes be unable to exit a house if the player is standing close to the doorway. Moving away from the door should allow the NPC to find their way out automatically.
Some pre-defined buildings on the map (other than those placed by the player) may not provide proper protection from cold or heat.
Occasionally after loading a game, the Side Quest category may not be selected by default and the quest needs to be selected again to track it.
After destroying animal enclosures, the surrounding fences may not be removed automatically. The player must destroy each fence manually or save and reload the game.
If you experience issues with the DualSense controller, restoring the control settings to default often resolves the problem.

Input hints are now shown during food selection.
The residents panel now uses a more contextual layout.

items.text: Howdy Partner!
We have another update applied on the beta branch for testing before releasing it. So, without further ado:
How do I play on a beta branch?
A quick guide:
Prerequisite: You must have Wild West Dynasty in your library – of course.
Open your games library. Right-click on Wild West Dynasty.
Open the ‘Properties’ menu.
Click on the ‘BETA’ tab.
Use the drop-down menu and select ‘Public Staging Branch’. This is the beta version of the game.
Click ‘Close’.
Steam should now download this version of the game.
Missing cutscene related to the Mercedes quest.
Pathfinding system improvements. NPCs should not become stuck if the destination is not reachable or blocked for it.
The cutscene music has been changed.
Cookbook recipes could not be analysed properly.
Manage House radial menu icon colour.
The house's custom name was not saved properly.
NPC were sleeping above the bed (their ability to levitate removed).
NPC could not be assigned properly to different Workstations if they are currently working in the stable.
Wrong map indicator for arable area.
Tools in the shop display were not stacking.
Rawhide was not displayed in the resources category.
Some technology recipes were not saved after unlocking them.
The campfire in the old camp could cause camera issues.

topNew: Missing cutscene related to the Mercedes quest.
Pathfinding system improvements. NPCs should not become stuck if the destination is not reachable or blocked for it.
The cutscene music has been changed.

items.text: Howdy Partner!
We're back! We have a new update for you that we'd like to test on the beta branch before releasing it into the wide-open spaces of the prairie. So, without further ado:
How do I play on a beta branch?
A quick guide:
Prerequisite: You must have Wild West Dynasty in your library – of course.
Open your games library. Right-click on Wild West Dynasty.
Open the ‘Properties’ menu.
Click on the ‘BETA’ tab.
Use the drop-down menu and select ‘Public Staging Branch’. This is the beta version of the game.
Click ‘Close’.
Steam should now download this version of the game.
The ability to move settlers to different houses
A panel to manage houses in Management tab
The ability to have more than one settler in one house
The ability to assign a house to yourself
Indicator in radial menu showing that crafting multiple is RMB
Resource list the player needs for buildings in the building wheel
Added more save slots and the ability to label them. Saves can now be deleted.
The ability to name horses
The ability to destroy just tents
The ability to paint the roof triangle on a house
Added 32 new investigation recipes (for cooking)
More saddles are available for purchase at Four Nines
Removed Annie's mail from the ground
Horse options to mount/dismount and a horse menu
The map is centring on the player when opened
Local transport now does not cost any money (in range of a city)

Transport system has been updated – after removing a city, every transport will be updated. If the destination for a transport is a removed city – the transport will be cancelled and will return to the starting point.
Removed the seeds tutorial/tip
Removed Ed's and Roger's tutorial/tip
Annie now marks her promised location.
All fires supply warmth now
The first fire should not have the Analyse option
Created a marker for “can be eaten” for NPCs in the menu. It is a checkmark instead of an X.
Granger’s behaviour when dead
Items stacking is now working
All the buildings are now destructible. Including the warehouse! And the Barn!
Fixed an issue where post-processing was not working in animal’s buildings (barn/pigsty/ranch/stable)
Fixed an issue where the detection of animal buildings was not working properly (player could not see name or health of the building)
Fixed an issue where the Barn was not showing its name and health and could not be destroyed
Fixed wrong names displayed on animal’s buildings
Fixed an issue with loading map state after save/load
Fixed an issue with loading Granger’s state
Fixed an issue where the Barn’s marker was not visible on the map after loading a saved file
Fixed an issue where the Windmill marker was not visible on the map after loading a saved file
Fixed an issue where the Mine marker was not visible on the map after loading a saved file
Fixed the de-synchronisation of animals
Fixed an issue with roof material in winter
Food now is updated on a daily basis, instead of every hour (food loses 40 points of condition per day)
Fixed an issue where items prepared with the cookbook were not transferred into rotten food if their condition reached 0
Granger, Owl and Grama Lucy now offer things to buy after reaching a certain point in the storyline
Fixed an issue with scroll in the Journal and notes panel

A panel to manage houses in Management tab
The ability to have more than one settler in one house

items.text: Howdy Partner!
We hold in our hands yet another hotfix for you, which brings these changes:
Added a rifle to the shop in Hope.
Four more colts were added to the shop in Hope.
Added Rifle ammo to the shop in Hope.
Added separate support for the General Store vendor’s storage.
Added a saver for the vendor in the General Store (On existing saves he replenishes items he is selling).
Horse selector map - fixed the scaling for 16:10 aspect ratio.
Animal's stable selector UI - fixed the scaling for 16:10 aspect ratio.
Fixed an issue with City mission that requires Sheriff building at City level 2.
Fixed an issue where the General Store required at City level 3.
Fixed an issue with the technology UI to match the new order (General store available at City level 2).
The General Store will now sell items at 50% base sale price
Fixed a chest collider in the stone mine.
Fixed a chest collider in the iron mine.
Fixed a building collider in the stone mine.
Fixed a building collider in the iron mine
Fixed an issue where the storage of the General Store's vendor storage was identical to the General Store's chest.

The General Store's vendor sells items at 75% of the original price.

items.text: Howdy Partner!
We have prepared another hotfix for you, which brings these fixes and optimisations!
We are working on more fixes! Thank you for your ongoing support!
Fixed an issue where skill points were displayed in Spanish.
Fixed animals for purchase in Taxation.
Red Rock - Fixed the NPC T-Poses after assignment.
Fixed the scrolling in the inventory after selecting any filter.
Ghost Town Forest - Adjusted parameters to prevent trees from spawning inside houses).
Grandma Lucy – Added a furniture saver.
You are back - Replaced beans with a can of beans.
Fixed an issue where a stable was not destructible.
Bridge area forest - Adjusted parameters to prevent trees from spawning in undesired places.
Henrietta – Can now be caged (support for existing saves is WIP).
Added a settler camp beyond Ed's farm.
Added a settler camp nearby the old shooting range.
Added a settler camp nearby Serenity Stand.
Updated the navmesh to support new settler camps and to improve the navigation in several areas at Red Rock.
Fixed an issue with the storage UI on ultra-wide resolutions.
Fixed an issue with detecting hovering over items in the storage UI for all resolutions.
Added a furniture saver to Granger's house.
Fixed an issue where data could not be loaded properly after the last update.
Taxation's cemetery becomes active once the entry Warehouse plans: Fix the Warehouse is active.
The destroyed convoy is disabled once the entry Warehouse plans: Fix the Warehouse is active.

Howdy Partner!
We’re starting this week with another hotfix bringing a few changes.
We are working on further updates! Thank you for your active support!
Improved the system for placing animals at a farm (the fence collision system was altered).
The windmill can now be destroyed.
Added a health bar to the windmill UI.
UI: Unified vertical scrollbar in Shop Panel.
UI: Unified vertical scrollbar in Pantry Panel.
UI: Unified vertical scrollbar in Food Storage Panel (animal stable/animal cage/city warehouse).
UI: Unified vertical scrollbar in Water Storage Panel (animal stable/animal cage/city warehouse).
UI: Fixed an issue with horizontal scrolling in the Pantry building.
Fixed an issue where only a single animal in the stable was feeding.
The player can craft seeds at the Barn's crafting station now.
Added a new item: Animal fodder.
The player can craft animal fodder at the Barn's crafting station now.
Animal fodder is transported to animal stables or cages by NPC by default.
Women's hair updated to partially remove intense mirror effect.
Fixed an issue where the Coal Mine was creating an error which locked the city progress from saving.
Updated the map colliders and streams (alpha walls were removed, the map is now more organic).
Optimization in Hope's gun shop.
Fixed an issue where the store UI could experience high memory usage after many transactions.
Barn: Added flower seeds to the production queue.
Barn: Added missing resource seeds to the production queue.
Barn: Added animal fodder to the production queue.
NPC working in an animal stable, or cage will now deliver 5 food items in each cycle.
Barn – equipped the crafting station inside to replace the crop dryer.
Added a chest in the sawmill so the player can collect items manually without having them transported.
Added a chest in front of the stone/iron mine so the player can collect things manually.
Added a chest to every animal stable so the player can collect things manually.
Players can now buy turkeys at the 9999 Ranch.
Fixed an issue where the player received stacks of tools from the shop.
Fixed an issue where the saddle could not be unequipped after saving/loading.
Fixed an issue where horse equipment was not visible after saving/loading.
Added missing recipes for the cookbook.
Cookbook: the UI was improved to support multiple food effects.
Fixed an issue where clicking "E" was triggering an action (like closing the options panel/opening the save panel) in the background once the controller mapper was active.
Fixed an issue where key binds were not working properly on non-QWERTY keyboards.
Fixed an issue where the pause menu or the settings menu could not process inputs.
Additional stock supplied for both Momma J and Hope's Food shop to boost more recipes.
Updated visuals to Hope.
Fixed an issue with Hope's Warehouse (missing assets).
Updated and added missing icons for cookbook recipes.
Howdy Partner!
Again a small hotfix bringing a few fixes.
We are working on further updates! Thank you for your active support!
NPCs will not kill young animals in cages (less than 10 years).
NPCs will transfer a maximum of two food items into the cage from storage in one cycle.
The food and water consumption of caged animals is significantly reduced.
NPCs assigned to cages housing animals should no longer trigger a crouch-stand-crouch action when managing the cage.

NPCs assigned to animal cages will now transfer water/food for animals. Condition: the cage does not contain 25 water units or 99 food units. (Dev note: We do want to give you a better option to manage animal cages. We are working on solutions. You will be able to control how many items the NPCs shall add to the cage's storage, to keep the economy and cycle balanced in your city.)
The water consumption for animals in barns is significantly reduced.
Fixed an issue where the player could plant seeds with insufficient amounts in the inventory (Note: this could have caused the -x value).
The Workshop craft hierarchy now reflects the technology tree.
The weight of Henrietta and Ada's letter are reduced to zero (0).
Fixed an issue where assigning NPCs to the Barn/Sawmill in Ghost Town could corrupt saving those buildings.
Fixed an issue where a transport route could break the saving process

Fixed an issue where having a windmill, farm plots and/or barn and having NPC assigned to the barn, could cause save issues. (Note: We are still investigating issues when sometimes buildings are not saved.)
Fixed an issue where a canteen was not providing water for NPCs in the city.
Fixed an issue where outpost buildings could not be destroyed.
NPCs working on a farm will take only as much seeds as required, depending on farm size.
Changed the cost of crafting a colt bullet from 10 shells and 10 gun powder, to 1 respectively.
Fixed an endless loop Mercedes – Confront the Sheriff.
Increased the health of houses.
Settlers are no longer eating up buckets. Empty buckets will be automatically returned to the warehouse storage. The support for animals is work in progress.
Howdy Partner!
Today we have a small update, but with an important addition.
We are working on further updates! Thank you for your active support!
Fixed an issue where the Settlers Camp was not randomizing settlers correctly.
The task: Have (x) specialists in the city will now work for any worker assigned to the city.
Most quest item weights are set to zero (0).
Added a save logger for debugging purposes.
Fixed a problem with displaying where a mine can be placed ("Can be placed on !").
Howdy Partner!
To start the week, we have another hotfix for you, which brings these bug fixes and optimisations!
We are working on further updates! Thank you for your active support!
Fixed an issue where the Pantry could freeze players after saving/loading.
Fixed an issue where items in Pantry could duplicate after saving/loading.
Fixed an issue where taking items from Pantry was corrupting them, if these items had the same definition (like for example mushrooms).
Removed corrupted food copies from pantry after saving/loading.
Animal cages now show the amount of food/water items available for these animals instead of corresponding progress bars.
Fixed an issue where flowers were not visible in animal cages as food.
Carter Ash cannot be assigned multiple times to a house.
Added a fallback if Grandma Lucy will glitch herself underground. After saving/loading she should be back on the surface.
Carter Ash cannot be talked to before starting The Promise.
You are back! - Elmer is now giving the player a key after the final quest.
The player cannot die as long as he is in the cooking panel.
Crafting planks – fixed an issue with a "nil" value displayed in the chapter entry.
Added destructible planks in the Granger house.
Fixed an issue where the trader was not selling a rifle.
Disabled the option to show the render debug panel.
Fixed an issue where the render debug view could be enabled.
Fixed an issue with extremely large sized saves. Shops could feature too many items - causing those saves – after loading. They will now reset to a default stock.
Fixed an issue where city missions could not be completed for specific requests of animal types.
Changed the Unstuck logic. Now the player will teleport to a nearby house after clicking Unstuck.
Default Unstuck position has changed to the start position in Ghost Town now if no houses are built yet.
Fixed an issue where jills (female hares) were not numbered to the chapter.
Fixed an issue where animals in cages could not reproduce.
Fixed an issue where NPCs were planting potatoes in winter only.
Fixed an issue where hired women had the wrong clothes. This also applies to women after loading from a save.
Fixed an issue where farm 4x4 had a wrong fertilizer decal.
Improved the NPC navigation on a farm. Now NPCs will try to find the nearest possible node to work on a farm instead of forcing themselves to the center of the farm.
Fixed an issue where unlocking technology by investigating plans was removing technology points.
Fixed an issue where some items (like Momma J's soup) were not restored after saving/loading.
Fixed an issue where NPCs planted more than the specified number of seeds in a given season.
Richard and Ed now sell bean seed (on existing saves the players have to wait a season for reset).

Added a key to Granger's chest for players with a broken quest state after save/load.
Fixed an issue where the focus was lost in the inventory when scrolling with the mouse wheel.

Optimization to animal spawners.

The chest in the ghost town is not interactable before the quest asked to collect food.

Added nails to the shops in Hope and Taxation (on existing saves players have to wait a season before the storage refreshes).

Fixed an issue with the display on how much money the player needs to upgrade the City.
Removed the misleading information "WIP" in the missions panel.
Fixed an issue where Mines and the Barn are not visible to assign settlers via its settler menu.
Fixed an issue where putting water/food to the warehouse was not detected as chapter.
A bottle of water will now serve as a drinkable item to NPCs.
Fixed several issues with doors in Ghost Town.
Fixed problem with investigating Owl's mushroom stew (+ secret recipe added).
Owl's stews bestow 30 food points instead of 10 now.
Momma J and the trader in Hope do sell cans of beans now Taxation (on existing saves players have to wait a season before the storage refreshes).
Animals transport cost adjusted to 30$ as a static value (distances are neglectable now).
Removed a misleading popup about assigning animals to a farm.
Updated seed descriptions
Fixed an issue where Momma J’s shop was not available after completing Aid for Taxation

items.text: Howdy Cowboys and Cowgirls!
It's time for another update, which provides several bug fixes and updates several things.
New for example are the flowers as agricultural items. In addition, there is a new system for building walls. And there are craftable paints you can freely use to color your houses!
Furthermore we have a new roadmap for you to give an outlook on coming content updates.
So, go ahead, rush into the Desert Bloom!

issues.text: In some cases, if a building is placed on a high foundation, NPCs may not be able to properly navigate to their destination. This can cause them to walk around the building instead of reaching the target point. As a temporary workaround, NPCs may occasionally be repositioned to the correct location.
In some cases, NPCs may appear in a T-pose after loading the game. Moving away from the NPC should cause the issue to resolve automatically.
NPCs may sometimes be unable to exit a house if the player is standing close to the doorway. Moving away from the door should allow the NPC to find their way out automatically.
Some pre-defined buildings on the map (other than those placed by the player) may not provide proper protection from cold or heat.
Occasionally after loading a game, the Side Quest category may not be selected by default and the quest needs to be selected again to track it.
After destroying animal enclosures, the surrounding fences may not be removed automatically. The player must destroy each fence manually or save and reload the game.
If you experience issues with the DualSense controller, restoring the control settings to default often resolves the problem.
